scope.summary: Implement channel-derived collision proxies per Section 13.24 (REQ-023): capsule/sphere/SDF body proxies generated mechanically from channel state via the MT-541 autocollider lane, with multi-sphere breast decomposition whose sphere count/radii/placement are driven by the breast channels (volume, projection, spacing), and proxy rows that auto-update on every channel change so cloth always collides against the current body.
acceptance_criteria: Capsule/sphere/SDF proxy sets are generated purely from channel state + region masks (no hand-placed colliders); the generation function is deterministic — identical channel state yields an identical proxy set.

Multi-sphere breast decomposition: sphere count, radii, and placement respond to breast volume/projection/spacing channels; at extreme-large volume the decomposition still encloses the breast surface within a typed tolerance (no cloth tunneling gap between spheres).
Proxy rows auto-update on TAILOR_BODY_ChannelChanged with no manual regeneration call; stale-proxy detection fails validation if proxy channel-state hash differs from the body's current state.
Proxies register in the unified cloth collision world with correct units/transforms; a drape against archetype-(a)-class channels collides against the updated proxies, not the base shape.
scope.risk_if_missed: Cloth would drape against stale or base-shape collision geometry, reproducing Daz's exact extreme-body failure (garments intersecting huge tits/ass) and invalidating every drape result downstream.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > BodyKit, Cloth, and contact integration

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Reconcile the BodyKit cloth bridge with shared topology/material/collider snapshots, the per-tier interaction matrix, portal-aware cavity metadata, final f64 authority, and promotion-safe receipts without expanding BodyKit anatomy authoring in this slice.
Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
